+# Specification: Corriger diagnostics de subprocess dans assertSuccess et requireSuccess
+
+## Problem Statement
+
+Les méthodes privées `assertSuccess` (runtime.ts:681-686) et `requireSuccess` (gitPromotion.ts:523-530) masquent le stdout lorsque stderr est présent. Le code actuel utilise `result.stderr.trim() || result.stdout.trim()` qui retourne uniquement stderr si non-vide, ignorant complètement stdout même si celui-ci contient des informations diagnostiques importantes.
+
+## Solution
+
+Corriger le formatage des messages d'erreur pour afficher les deux flux (stderr et stdout) de manière distincte et complète, avec stderr en premier si non-vide, suivi de stdout si non-vide. Utiliser le format : `Unable to <action>: [stderr] <trimmed_message>\n[stdout] <trimmed_message>`. Si les deux flux sont vides, afficher `Unable to <action>: exit code N`.
+
+## User Stories
+
+1. As a developer, I want to see both stderr and stdout error messages from subprocess failures, so that I can diagnose issues more effectively without missing critical information
+2. As a maintainer, I want stderr to be displayed before stdout in error messages, so that error streams follow conventional logging practices
+3. As a tester, I want empty streams to be excluded from error messages, so that I only see relevant diagnostic information
+4. As a user, I want to see the exit code when both streams are empty, so that I have minimal diagnostic information for the failure
+5. As a developer, I want success cases to remain unchanged, so that existing behavior is preserved for non-error scenarios
+
+## Implementation Decisions
+
+- **Error message format**: `Unable to <action>: [stderr] <trimmed_message>\n[stdout] <trimmed_message>` with real newline character between streams
+- **Display order**: stderr first if non-empty, then stdout if non-empty
+- **Stream filtering**: Only include non-empty trimmed streams in the error message
+- **Fallback behavior**: `Unable to <action>: exit code N` when both stderr and stdout are empty
+- **Success preservation**: No changes to success case handling
+- **Method preservation**: All private methods and interfaces remain unchanged; no duplication, truncation, or deduplication
+- **File scope**: Changes limited to `acp-sandbox/src/runtime.ts` (assertSuccess) and `acp-sandbox/src/gitPromotion.ts` (requireSuccess)
+

+

+  3. Stdout only (stderr empty)
+  4. No streams (both empty)
+  5. Success case (no error)
+- **Existing tests**: Update affected expectations in runtime and promotion tests to match new error message format
+- **Execution**: `npm ci` at root then `npm test` at root with real exit codes
+

+
+- No changes to private/any access modifiers
+- No package.json/lock/dependency modifications
+- No ADR or glossary updates

+- No historical audits or transcriptions

+# Specification: Corriger diagnostics de subprocess dans assertSuccess et requireSuccess
+
+## Problem Statement
+
+Les méthodes privées `assertSuccess` (runtime.ts:681-686) et `requireSuccess` (gitPromotion.ts:523-530) masquent le stdout lorsque stderr est présent. Le code actuel utilise `result.stderr.trim() || result.stdout.trim()` qui retourne uniquement stderr si non-vide, ignorant complètement stdout même si celui-ci contient des informations diagnostiques importantes.
+
+## Solution
+
+Corriger le formatage des messages d'erreur pour afficher les deux flux (stderr et stdout) de manière distincte et complète, avec stderr en premier si non-vide, suivi de stdout si non-vide. Utiliser le format : `Unable to <action>: [stderr] <trimmed_message>\n[stdout] <trimmed_message>`. Si les deux flux sont vides, afficher `Unable to <action>: exit code N`.
+
+## User Stories
+
+1. As a developer, I want to see both stderr and stdout error messages from subprocess failures, so that I can diagnose issues more effectively without missing critical information
+2. As a maintainer, I want stderr to be displayed before stdout in error messages, so that error streams follow conventional logging practices
+3. As a tester, I want empty streams to be excluded from error messages, so that I only see relevant diagnostic information
+4. As a user, I want to see the exit code when both streams are empty, so that I have minimal diagnostic information for the failure
+5. As a developer, I want success cases to remain unchanged, so that existing behavior is preserved for non-error scenarios
+
+## Implementation Decisions
+
+- **Error message format**: `Unable to <action>: [stderr] <trimmed_message>\n[stdout] <trimmed_message>` with real newline character between streams
+- **Display order**: stderr first if non-empty, then stdout if non-empty
+- **Stream filtering**: Only include non-empty trimmed streams in the error message
+- **Fallback behavior**: `Unable to <action>: exit code N` when both stderr and stdout are empty
+- **Success preservation**: No changes to success case handling
+- **Method preservation**: All private methods and interfaces remain unchanged; no duplication, truncation, or deduplication
+- **File scope**: Changes limited to `acp-sandbox/src/runtime.ts` (assertSuccess) and `acp-sandbox/src/gitPromotion.ts` (requireSuccess)
+
+## Testing Decisions
+
+- **Test location**: `acp-sandbox/test/runtime.test.ts`
+- **Test approach**: 5 public API tests for `runCodex` using `fakeExecutor`/`sandboxScenario`
+- **Test coverage**:
+  1. Two streams (both stderr and stdout non-empty)
+  2. Stderr only (stdout empty)
+  3. Stdout only (stderr empty)
+  4. No streams (both empty)
+  5. Success case (no error)
+- **Existing tests**: Update affected expectations in runtime and promotion tests to match new error message format
+- **Execution**: `npm ci` at root then `npm test` at root with real exit codes
+
+## Out of Scope
+
+- No changes to private/any access modifiers
+- No package.json/lock/dependency modifications
+- No ADR or glossary updates
+- No tail/pipefail/tsx usage
+- No historical audits or transcriptions
+- No duplication of existing functionality
+
